# Phase 6 local controlled workload

**Status: measured locally; not a hosted or production result.** Generated by
`uv run --project backend python -m incident_lens.validation.performance
--samples 20` on 2026-09-14. The workload uses only the authored
`checkout-failure` fixture (`fixture-v1`) and the Phase 5 JSONL sample
(`phase5-upload-v1`). Final-held-out data was not opened.

| Workload | Samples | p50 | p95 | Completion/recovery |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| Create, run, and retrieve authored fixture run | 20 | 3.330 ms | 6.298 ms | 20/20 completed (1.0) |
| Validate supported JSONL upload | 20 | 0.599 ms | 1.103 ms | 20/20 accepted; 60 records |
| Cancel deferred run, then retry | 20 | not separately timed | not separately timed | 20/20 recovered (1.0) |

Upload workload details: 390 bytes and 3 records per request, bounded by the
10 MiB and 10,000-record service limits. The measurement retains sample sizes,
fixture versions, and workload version `phase6-local-controlled-v1` in the
command output.

Provider cost, hosted provider latency, live connector latency, public
deployment latency, and complete-investigation quality are **not measured**.
These values are useful for regression checks on this machine and fixture only;
they are not scale, reliability, or user-impact claims. Re-run the command
after implementation changes and record the environment and versions before
comparing results.
